title: Warm Spicy Moroccan Scotch Bonnet Msemen
description: A spicy and crumbly Moroccan dish featuring scotch bonnet peppers, shio-koji cure, and anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients, all wrapped in a lotus leaf.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
In a small bowl, mix together shio-koji, turmeric, ginger, salt, and black pepper.
Add the diced scotch bonnet peppers to the bowl and stir to combine.
Roll out the msemen dough to a thin layer and cut into 4 equal pieces.
Brush the dough pieces with olive oil and sprinkle with the scotch bonnet pepper mixture.
Top each dough piece with a few slices of onion and a sprinkle of minced garlic.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a triangle or square shape, and press the edges together to seal.
Place the msemen in the preheated skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy.
Wrap each msemen in a lotus leaf and serve warm.
